title: Those who are married, Mr Best, douce herald, said, all save one, shall live. The rest shall keep as they are
html_source:
Mr Best quotes Hamlet’s rejection of Ophelia in Act III, Scene 1:

I say, we will have no more marriages:
those that are married already, all but one, shall
live; the rest shall keep as they are. To a
nunnery, go.
